tag: 湖岸清潔活動集合地點改變

level.why: 三人討論先定泥濘的碼頭、後改涼亭並更動開始時間，需追蹤方案變化與說話意圖。

dialogue.t: Thanks for coming, everyone. We're planning the lakeshore cleanup for this Saturday, and we need to confirm where volunteers will meet.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝大家來。我們在規劃這週六的湖岸清潔活動，需要確認志工在哪裡集合。

dialogue.t: I thought we agreed on the boat ramp, since that's where most of the litter collects.
dialogue.zh: 我以為我們說好是船艇坡道，因為大部分垃圾都堆在那裡。

dialogue.t: We did, but I drove past this morning, and the whole ramp area is covered in mud from the storm.
dialogue.zh: 是說好了，但我今早開車經過，整個坡道區因為暴風雨滿是泥巴。

dialogue.t: That's a problem. Volunteers would be slipping around, and the garbage bags would get ruined.
dialogue.zh: 那是個問題。志工會一直滑倒，垃圾袋也會被弄壞。

dialogue.t: Then what about the pavilion near the picnic grounds? It has a paved floor and plenty of covered space.
dialogue.zh: 那野餐區旁的涼亭呢？它有鋪面地板，而且有很多有遮蔽的空間。

dialogue.t: That works for registration, but it's a ten-minute walk from the shoreline. Will people mind carrying the supplies?
dialogue.zh: 那裡適合報到，但離岸邊要走十分鐘。大家會介意搬器材嗎？

dialogue.t: Not if we use the park's wagons. I already asked the office, and they can lend us three.
dialogue.zh: 如果用公園的推車就不會。我已經問過辦公室，他們可以借我們三台。

dialogue.t: In that case, I support the pavilion. Should I tell the volunteers by email or by phone?
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話我支持涼亭。我該用電子郵件還是電話通知志工？

dialogue.t: Email is quicker. Could you send it out today and mention that we'll start at nine instead of eight?
dialogue.zh: 電子郵件比較快。你今天可以寄出，並說明我們改為九點開始而不是八點嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. Why the later start, though? I thought we wanted to finish before the afternoon heat.
dialogue.zh: 好。不過為什麼要晚一點開始？我以為我們想在下午高溫前結束。

dialogue.t: The park office won't unlock the supply shed until eight thirty, so nine is the earliest realistic time.
dialogue.zh: 公園辦公室八點半才會開器材棚，所以九點是最早合理的時間。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Reporting damage from a storm
choices.zh: 通報暴風雨造成的損害
choices.why: 暴風雨泥濘只是換地點的原因。

choices.t: Choosing a meeting place for a volunteer event
choices.zh: 為志工活動選擇集合地點
choices.why: 開場即說要確認志工集合地點，後續也圍繞地點與時間。

choices.t: Buying supplies for a picnic
Hiring workers for the park

q.t: Why do the speakers reject the boat ramp?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼不用船艇坡道？

choices.t: It is too far from the picnic grounds.
choices.why: 距離問題是在談涼亭到岸邊時提到的。

choices.t: The park office has closed it.
choices.zh: 公園辦公室把它關閉了。

choices.t: There is not enough room for volunteers.
The ground is muddy after the storm.
choices.why: W2 說整個坡道區被暴風雨弄得滿是泥巴。

q.t: Why does the man ask, "Why the later start, though?"
q.zh: 男士為什麼問「不過為什麼要晚一點開始？」

choices.t: He wants to know why the time changed.
choices.zh: 他想知道為何時間改變。
choices.why: 他對改為九點感到意外，並說明自己原本期望早點結束。

choices.t: He is refusing to send the email.
He is asking about the cost of wagons.
choices.why: 推車是先前談的，與此問題無關。

choices.t: He is suggesting an earlier finish.
choices.why: 他是想知道原因，而且擔心下午太熱，並不是提出新建議。

tag: 公司騎車活動由山路改為谷地環線

level.why: 三人對話先屬意山嶺路線、後依體力與條件改選，須結合圖表多項條件並判斷意圖與後續行動。

dialogue.t: Hi there. Are you ladies planning a group ride today?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，兩位女士是打算今天來辦團體騎乘嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, our company outing is next Friday. We have twenty people, and we want a route with good scenery.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們公司活動在下週五。我們有二十個人，想要風景好的路線。

dialogue.t: Originally we were thinking of the Ridge Trail, because the views are supposed to be the best.
dialogue.zh: 原本我們想選山嶺步道，因為據說風景最棒。

dialogue.t: They are, but it's a tough climb. Is everyone in your group an experienced rider?
dialogue.zh: 確實是，但爬坡很辛苦。你們團隊每個人都很有經驗嗎？

dialogue.t: Honestly, no. Half of them haven't ridden a bike in years, and the weather will be hot.
dialogue.zh: 老實說不是。有一半的人好幾年沒騎車了，而且天氣會很熱。

dialogue.t: Then the ridge is out. We want at least four rest stops, and nothing longer than twenty-five kilometers.
dialogue.zh: 那山嶺就不考慮了。我們要至少四個休息點，而且不要超過二十五公里。

dialogue.t: That narrows it down to just one route. It's a pretty ride with a gentle climb.
dialogue.zh: 那就只剩一條路線了。風景很美，爬坡也平緩。

dialogue.t: Perfect. Do you have a group price for twenty bikes?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。二十台車有團體價嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, groups of fifteen or more get a fifteen percent reduction if you book a week ahead.
dialogue.zh: 有，十五人以上的團體若提前一週預約可享八五折。

dialogue.t: We're exactly a week ahead, so we qualify. Could you hold twenty bikes for next Friday morning?
dialogue.zh: 我們剛好提前一週，所以符合。你可以幫我們保留二十台車給下週五早上嗎？

dialogue.t: Certainly. I'll need a name and phone number, and a payment of one hundred dollars to hold them.
dialogue.zh: 當然。我需要姓名和電話，還有一百美元的款項來保留車輛。

q.t: Why does the woman say, "Half of them haven't ridden a bike in years"?
q.zh: 這位女士為什麼說「有一半的人好幾年沒騎車了」？

choices.t: To explain why a hard route is unsuitable
choices.zh: 說明為何困難路線不適合
choices.why: 針對男士問是否都很有經驗，她說明一半的人久未騎車。

choices.t: To ask for a beginner lesson
To say the group wants a longer ride
choices.why: 她的意思是團隊體力有限。

choices.t: To request a discount

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which route will the women most likely choose?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這兩位女士最可能選哪條路線？

choices.t: River Path
choices.why: 長度符合，但只有三個休息點。

choices.t: Ridge Trail
Valley Loop
choices.why: 不選山嶺、至少四個休息點、不超過 25 公里，只有 Valley Loop 符合。

choices.t: Coast Run
choices.why: 休息點夠多，但 30 公里超過 25 公里上限。

q.t: What will the women most likely give the man?
q.zh: 這兩位女士接下來最可能給男士什麼？

choices.t: A map of the Ridge Trail
Their contact details and a payment
choices.why: 他要求姓名、電話與一百美元款項。

choices.t: A list of experienced riders
A new date for the outing

tag: 戶外音樂會因暴風雨改到音樂台

level.why: 三人討論先設草坪舞台、後因天氣改用音樂台，並比較多個方案，需判斷說話意圖。

dialogue.t: The concert in Riverside Park starts at seven, and the sound check is at four. Is the stage ready, Gary?
dialogue.zh: 河濱公園的音樂會七點開始，音響測試在四點。舞台準備好了嗎，Gary？

dialogue.t: Mostly. We built it on the main lawn, but the ground on the left side is still soft from yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了。我們把它蓋在主草坪上，但左側地面還因昨天的雨很軟。

dialogue.t: That's concerning. The radar shows storms rolling in around eight, so people might need cover.
dialogue.zh: 這讓人擔心。雷達顯示八點左右會有暴風雨，所以大家可能需要遮蔽處。

dialogue.t: Let's not panic yet. Can the band play under the bandshell near the playground instead?
dialogue.zh: 先別慌。樂團可以改在遊樂場旁的音樂台演出嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, but the bandshell holds only about four hundred people, while we sold six hundred tickets.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但音樂台只容納約四百人，而我們賣了六百張票。

dialogue.t: Then we could keep the show on the lawn and begin an hour earlier, so it ends before the storm.
dialogue.zh: 那我們可以維持在草坪，並提早一小時開始，這樣就能在暴風雨前結束。

dialogue.t: Starting at six is risky. Many ticket holders work until five thirty and wouldn't make it in time.
dialogue.zh: 六點開始很冒險。很多持票人五點半才下班，來不及趕到。

dialogue.t: True. How about a shorter program? We could start at seven and cut the second band.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。縮短節目如何？我們可以七點開始，並刪掉第二個樂團。

dialogue.t: The second band is the main attraction, though. People will be furious if they miss it.
dialogue.zh: 不過第二個樂團是主要賣點。如果錯過，大家會很生氣。

dialogue.t: Then the bandshell is our best option. We'll let the extra people stand on the paved plaza, and I'll rent a few big tents.
dialogue.zh: 那音樂台是最好的選擇。多出來的人可以站在鋪面廣場，我會租幾頂大帳篷。

dialogue.t: I'll update the signs and the website right now so nobody goes to the wrong place.
dialogue.zh: 我現在就更新告示牌和網站，這樣沒有人會去錯地方。

dialogue.t: Good. I'll also tell the security staff to keep the plaza clear of chairs.
dialogue.zh: 好。我也會告訴保全人員，不要讓廣場上放椅子。

q.t: Why is the bandshell a problem?
q.zh: 為什麼音樂台是個問題？

choices.t: It is still soft from the rain.
choices.why: 地面鬆軟的是草坪左側。

choices.t: It is too far from the lawn.
It can't hold everyone who bought tickets.
choices.zh: 它容納不下所有購票的人。
choices.why: 音樂台約四百人，但賣出六百張票。

choices.t: It is full of the band's equipment.

q.t: What does the director imply about the audience?
q.zh: 總監對觀眾暗示了什麼？

choices.t: Many can't arrive in time for a six o'clock start.
choices.zh: 許多人趕不上六點開始。
choices.why: 很多人五點半才下班，無法及時抵達。

choices.t: Most will skip the concert because of the storm.
choices.zh: 多數人會因暴風雨放棄。

choices.t: They prefer sitting on the lawn.
Many tickets remain unsold.

q.t: Why does the woman say, "The second band is the main attraction, though"?
q.zh: 這位女士為什麼說「不過第二個樂團是主要賣點」？

choices.t: To praise the technician's idea
To suggest adding more bands
To announce a band has canceled
To reject the idea of cutting a band
choices.zh: 否決刪掉一個樂團的點子
choices.why: 她是在回應男士刪掉第二個樂團的提議。
